subject.title: fix(github-copilot): preserve thinking levels for Claude models

question: Should this PR wait for redacted OpenClaw `/thinking high` proof on a real GitHub Copilot Claude model, or should a maintainer explicitly override the proof gate based on available Copilot credentials/provider context?
rationale: The code shape is focused and source-backed, but the external provider behavior cannot be fully verified from unit tests or repository source alone.

options.title: Require real Copilot proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a recording showing `/thinking high` succeeds through OpenClaw on a real GitHub Copilot Claude model before merge.

options.title: Override as maintainer-owned proof
options.body: A maintainer with Copilot credentials can explicitly accept the related provider proof and own the remaining live-path risk.

options.title: Pause until credentials are available
options.body: Keep the PR open without merging until someone can run the exact OpenClaw user path against Copilot.

recommendation.title: Require real Copilot proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a recording showing `/thinking high` succeeds through OpenClaw on a real GitHub Copilot Claude model before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He recently reviewed and closed the overlapping Copilot thinking PR in favor of this provider-policy path.
